# Keyboard shortcuts

These are the default keys. The **Key** column is the key you press. The **Key string** column is the name termocode uses in `keymap.json`.

!!! note "Your terminal may take some keys"
    Some keys never reach termocode because the terminal uses them (for example `Ctrl+Shift+T`, `Ctrl+Shift+W`, `F11`). That is why some actions have more than one key. Every action is also in the command palette (`F1`).

## File

| Key | Key string | Action | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+R` | `ctrl+r` | `OpenRecent` | Pick a recently opened file. |
| `Ctrl+Q` | `ctrl+q` | `Quit` | Quit termocode. |
| `Ctrl+S` | `ctrl+s` | `Save` | Save the active file. |

## Editor keys (Neovim)

The editor is real Neovim. termocode adds these keys inside Neovim. They are not in `keymap.json`; change them with your own Neovim config. All normal Vim keys work too.

| Key | Mode | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `F12 / gd` | Normal | Go to definition (LSP). |
| `gD` | Normal | Go to declaration (LSP). |
| `gi` | Normal | Go to implementation (LSP). |
| `gr / Shift+F12` | Normal | List references (LSP). |
| `gt` | Normal | Go to type definition (LSP). |
| `K` | Normal | Hover documentation (LSP). |
| `F2` | Normal | Rename symbol (LSP). |
| `Ctrl+Space` | Normal | Signature help (LSP). |
| `Ctrl+Space` | Insert | Open completion. |
| `<leader>f` | Normal | Format the buffer (LSP). |
| `Tab / Enter` | Insert | Accept the completion item. Tab also accepts AI ghost text and jumps to the next snippet field. |
| `Shift+Tab` | Insert | Previous completion item, or previous snippet field. |
| `Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y` | Insert | Undo / redo. |
| `Alt+Up / Alt+Down` | All | Move the line or selection up / down. |
| `Shift+Alt+Up / Shift+Alt+Down` | All | Duplicate the line or selection up / down. |
| `Ctrl+D` | Normal | Multi-cursor: select the next match of the word. |
| `Ctrl+Alt+Up / Ctrl+Alt+Down` | Normal, Insert | Multi-cursor: add a cursor above / below. |
| `]x / [x` | Normal | Next / previous merge conflict. |
| `F4 / Shift+F4` | Normal, Insert | Next / previous Find in Files result. Note: today the app keys F4 (ToggleInlayHints) and Shift+F4 (ReopenClosed) catch these keys first. |
| `Esc` | Insert | Back to Normal mode — the editor is real Neovim. |

## Change a key

Use **Preferences: Customize Keybindings** in the palette, or edit `~/.config/termocode/keymap.json` (or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/termocode/keymap.json`). The file maps a key string to an action name from the tables above:

```json
{
  "alt+s": "Save",
  "alt+h": "ext:hello.say"
}
```

Rules:

- The key string must be one of the key strings in the tables above. Other keys are ignored.
- A new entry takes the key from its old action. The old action keeps its other keys.
- A value `"ext:<command id>"` runs an extension command. For these, any key string works.
- Unknown action names are ignored. A broken file never stops termocode from starting.
